title: Studio publish dialog lists an update to an already-published view as 「新增 · 发布后将新增此项」
body:
Filing category: ① product defect (misleading review screen).
reach: public entry — Studio › 发布 in a browser (Playwright, zh-CN), measured on a hosted tenant (`pnpm dev:stack --with-ui`; cloud `ff373e02`, framework `d7c3d44e`).

## Business reason

The publish dialog is where a person reviews what an AI client drafted before it goes live. If an edit reads as "new", the reviewer cannot tell that a live form layout is about to change.

## Steps

1. Draft and publish view `ebqu_claim.default` (form layout) — the first publish lists it as 新增 (correct).
2. Over MCP: `update_metadata { type: 'view', name: 'ebqu_claim.default', patch: { form: { … span: 'full' … } } }` → `Drafted update to view`, `changedKeys: ['form']`.
3. Studio › 发布.

## What happens

The dialog shows `报销单 · ebqu_claim.default · 新增 · 发布后将新增此项。` In the same dialog, the other edited view `ebqu_claim.by_status` reads `更新` with its changed keys (`~ 列 · ~ 看板`). After publishing, the form shows the new layout, so it was an update of the live view.

## Expected

An update to a published view reads 更新 with what changes (here `~ 表单`), as the sibling view does.

Reader who acts: the Studio seat (publish-drafts diff in `ui/apps/console`), possibly the metadata seat if the draft is diffed against the wrong base for `<object>.default` views.
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue publish dialog view shown as new existing` → 66 hits (#30057 closed: Studio Data 表单 edits a layout users never see — related surface, different defect); none on this label.
